title: Design System: BioImage 工具平台与 WB 证据工作台

body.purpose: Qt 10pt，标题独立使用 QSS px。

platform-tool.purpose: Qt QSS 22px/600; current WB tool entry.

platform-section.purpose: Qt QSS 15px/600; navigation, recent projects and flow details.

nativePlatform.navigation: Horizontal list, 220×44 cells, 48 height; selected bottom border 3px primary; selected tabs bottom border 2px primary.
nativePlatform.layout: WB analysis: 220px controls / flexible evidence / 292px review, 10px gaps. Source: 224px source rail / flexible canvas / 272px review, 12px gaps. Platform: 216px navigation / flexible tools and recent projects / 270px project details.
nativePlatform.focus: Buttons: 2px primary border. Line edits, integer spin boxes and combo boxes: primary border color.
nativePlatform.previewPolicy: Native Qt only; no fabricated HTML/CSS preview components or synthesized tonal ramps. Fit/100% is display-only.
nativePlatform.platformEnumException: Windows custom Qt Widgets is not represented by Impeccable 4.5.2 web/ios/android/adaptive enums. Keep truthful PRODUCT.md; inspect native QSS/layout manually. Web fallback does not authorize changing technology or fabricated web component previews.
nativePlatform.verification: Source workspace actual Qt synthetic fixture screenshots inspected at logical 1440x900 and 1100x780; source regression suite 36 passed. Final integrated platform/real-resource workflow screenshots and output validation belong to main T-024 task; not implied by design metadata.
workingTreeAmendments: T-024 coordinator: analysis review 292px; 4 significant-digit compact values; wrapped non-elided status; original-integral review column.
T-024 coordinator: laboratory source labels use three-digit project-order prefix with stable row_id and filename in tooltip.

evidenceDrawing.scope: Local scientific plot drawing, not general shell tokens.
evidenceDrawing.axisMeaning: Y: signal mean in original grayscale units under quantification polarity; X: crop row index starting at 0. Actual data ticks and L/R labels; verified results only.

nativeComponents.name: Platform buttons
nativeComponents.qss: QPushButton { background: #ffffff; color: #24363b; border: 1px solid #cbd8dd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 18px; } QPushButton:hover { background: #eaf5f3; border-color: #087677; } QPushButton:focus { border: 2px solid #087677; } QPushButton:pressed { background: #dff1ed; } QPushButton:disabled { background: #edf1f3; color: #697a84; border-color: #dce4e9; }

nativeComponents.name: Platform primary action
nativeComponents.qss: QPushButton#primaryAction { background: #087677; color: #ffffff; border-color: #087677; font-weight: 600; } QPushButton#primaryAction:hover { background: #096568; }

nativeComponents.name: Source list
nativeComponents.qss: QListWidget#sourceList { border: 0; background: #ffffff; outline: none; } QListWidget#sourceList::item { padding: 9px 6px; border-radius: 5px; } QListWidget#sourceList::item:selected { background: #e1f2ee; color: #096568; } QListWidget#sourceList::item:hover { background: #eff7f6; }

nativeComponents.name: Source metadata fields
nativeComponents.layout: Fig / protein / lane count / excluded lanes. 8px spacing; shared advanced table state; original coordinate fields stay in advanced tab.

nativeComponents.name: Crop canvas
nativeComponents.behavior: Left drag inside crop moves; edge or corner drag resizes; release emits original-pixel half-open ROI; unchanged click does not emit; wheel zoom 1..12, middle drag pans, double click resets zoom. Lane overlays update during drag.

nativeComponents.name: Analysis review summary
nativeComponents.layout: 292px review rail; table 130..180px high; columns lane/effective signal/status/raw integral pending review. Fixed first columns 32/66/76px, final column stretches.
nativeComponents.format: Compact numerical cells use .4g only; complete project result table/export retain existing precision. WordWrap=True, ElideNone, resizeRowsToContents. Raw integral is separate from effective signal and excluded from normalization until quality policy permits.

nativeComponents.name: Laboratory source identity
nativeComponents.format: {current project source index:03d} · {protein}; tooltip contains full filename and stable row_id. Same source across multiple segments keeps one prefix; numbering is display identity within current ordering, not a replacement for row_id.

sourceCanvasDrawing.coordinatePolicy: Original-pixel half-open rectangle, including zoom and focused regions. Display raster is never a numerical input.

automaticState.currentEvidence: row_is_ready matches source SHA, crop, lane count, excluded lanes and normalized-revision request; human row.reviewed is separate.
automaticState.scope: Core evidence contract plus integrated host workflow; final real-resource output validation belongs to main T-024 task.
automaticState.sourcePresentation: Source rail distinguishes human-confirmed / crop ready pending review / awaiting recognition and appends source notes. Expired and failed result semantics remain in analysis/results/report; existence of a crop alone is not proof of current machine provenance.

narrative.overview:
冷白平台入口与白色工作区承载项目、工具和结果，深色画布承载原始图像。青绿用于主要动作和当前选择，系统中文字体保证长时间操作的清晰度。沿用用户选择的 A「证据工作台」，将相同的视觉语言扩展到可见工具平台和原图三栏工作区。

本次增量来源为平台 `f32ebbb` 的 `platform_window.py`、原图工作区与画布 `e2d78e6`，并核对 T-024 协调工作树的最终改动：定量复核栏扩为 292px、摘要格式与状态换行、拼图来源序号。其余定量、OCR、拼图和导出视觉规则沿用 T-023 `0d9aad94`。原图页 1440×900 与 1100×780 的实际 Qt 合成截图已检查；平台最终集成截图和真实资源完整运行由主任务补充，不能从这些设计记录推断科学准确率。

这是 Windows 自定义 Qt Widgets 设计语言。Impeccable 当前没有相应 Platform 枚举，按原生界面手工提取尺寸、QSS 和绘制行为；不把桌面控件伪报成网页组件或移动端组件。
keyCharacteristics: 可见工具平台：工具入口、项目动作和最近项目。
WB 顶部横向阶段导航，来源与操作在左、图像居中、结果复核在右。
自动化为主要操作；精确坐标与批量元数据保留在高级入口。
机器建议、人工复核和过期状态有各自含义，颜色不代替状态文字。
图像显示与定量数据分离。

rules.name: The Evidence Canvas Rule
rules.body: 画布的固定绘制色只编码证据视图，不改变原始像素、定量结果或输出数据。

dos: Do 从实际 Qt palette、QSS 和绘制实现延续角色。
Do 同步当前来源、泳道参数、图像、曲线与核验结果。
Do 将自动识别和图上修正作为默认操作，精确坐标作为高级补充。
Do 保留机器建议、人工复核、过期和失败的独立文字状态。
Do 显示真实坐标单位、边界含义、缺失与排除状态。
donts: Don't 恢复已被替换的石墨侧栏或 lime 导航规则。
Don't 将显示映射、预览缩放或导航选中当作定量与完成证据。
Don't 虚构网页组件、断点、旧版拖基线功能或统一错误样式。
